# Asset provenance

* WhiteSur GTK theme, icon theme, cursor theme: upstream projects by vinceliuice;
  follow the license and attribution files in each fetched checkout.
* Inter and DejaVu: Debian-packaged open fonts; no Apple fonts are used.
* Wallpaper: original SVG authored for this project; no Apple image is copied.
* Papirus and Adwaita icons: Debian-packaged open-source icon sets.
* Freedesktop sound theme: Debian package.
* Firmware: provided by Debian firmware packages or fetched by their installer;
  firmware redistribution terms vary by device and package. See Debian package
  copyright files and upstream firmware notices.
